notes.subject: רגל
notes.rationale: Lemma e bolela 'go sepela / go lelela ka mahlo (go ba mohlokomedi)'; ba fetoledi ba bodiša 'go hlolela' kgahlanong le 'go bolela diphiri' — mo, go hlolela ka leleme

notes.subject: לרעהו רעה
notes.rationale: Go swana ga modumo magareng ga rea/mogwera (רעה) le bobe (רע) — thwii ya mantswe a mabedi, e lahwago ka Sepedi

notes.subject: נשא על
notes.rationale: 'Go bea tlhegiso mo go' — seheberu se bolela 'go godisa go tlhohlela'; Sepedi e šomiša 'go bea' bjalo ka seswantšho sa go amogela seo mmadi a se bolelago

translation: Ga a hlolela ka leleme la gagowo; ga a dira sebe mo go mogwera wa gagowo; gomme tlhegiso ga e e bea mo go wa kgauswi wa gagowo.
